## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-facing problem and what changes.

## Verification

List checks actually run, their results, and anything not verified.

## Review notes

- [ ] Relevant specifications and user instructions match the change.
- [ ] If users or server operators will notice this change, `docs/changelog.md` describes it under **Unreleased** and includes any required upgrade steps.
- [ ] Fixtures, screenshots and logs contain synthetic data only.
- [ ] No secrets, exports, database snapshots or private configuration are included.
- [ ] Migration/compatibility and recovery implications are documented where applicable.
- [ ] Third-party code/assets have redistribution permission and required attribution.
